# qpcr: `QpcrReport`

The `data` payload of `openreadout analyze qpcr FILE --json` (`--cq`, `--ddcq`, `--standard-curve`), inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

Output of `qpcr_report`.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/qpcr.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/qpcr.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema qpcr`.

## Fields

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | yes | The input file. |
| `format` | `string` | yes | Format id. |
| `dialect` | `string` | yes | Dialect (`rdml`, `eds-sds`, `eds-7500`, `eds-json`, `rex`). |
| `experiment` | `string` or `null` |  | Experiment or run name. |
| `instrument` | `string` or `null` |  | Instrument model. |
| `acquisition_temperature_c` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Temperature of the step that reads fluorescence during cycling (the annealing / extension temperature of a two-step PCR), °C. |
| `cycles` | `integer` (uint32) or `null` |  | Number of PCR cycles in the program. |
| `reference_targets` | array of `string` | yes | Reference targets used or recorded (endogenous controls). |
| `control_sample` | `string` or `null` |  | Control (calibrator) sample used or recorded. |
| `record_count` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Records matching the filters. |
| `truncated` | `boolean` | yes | True when `max_records` cut the list. |
| `records` | array of [`QpcrAssayRecord`](#qpcrassayrecord) | yes | The records. |
| `cq_counts` | [`CqCounts`](#cqcounts) | yes | Cq statuses over every record that matches the filters (not cut by `max_records`). |
| `targets` | array of [`TargetCqSummary`](#targetcqsummary) | yes | Per target: counts by Cq status and the mean Cq without the undetermined results. |
| `undetermined_cq` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Cq used for undetermined results in the aggregates, when the request gave one. |
| `cq_comparison` | [`CqComparison`](#cqcomparison) or `null` |  | Our Cq against the vendor's (with `compute_cq`). |
| `relative_quantities` | array of [`RelativeQuantity`](#relativequantity) | yes | ΔΔCq results (with `relative`). |
| `standard_curves` | array of [`StandardCurveFit`](#standardcurvefit) | yes | Standard curves (with `standard_curve`). |
| `notes` | array of `string` | yes | What to keep in mind. |

## Types

### QpcrAssayRecord

One well × target, with names resolved.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `run` | `string` | yes | Run (plate) name. |
| `well` | `string` | yes | Well name (`A1`). |
| `row` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Plate row, 1-based. |
| `col` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Plate column, 1-based. |
| `sample` | `string` or `null` |  | Sample name. |
| `target` | `string` or `null` |  | Target (assay, detector, gene). |
| `dye` | `string` or `null` |  | Reporter dye. |
| `task` | `string` or `null` |  | Role of the well for this target: `unknown`, `standard`, `ntc`, `nac`, `ntp`, `nrt`, `positive`, ... |
| `quantity` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Given quantity (standards). |
| `cq` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Cq (Ct) as the vendor software or RDML file reports it. |
| `cq_undetermined` | `boolean` | yes | True when the file says there is no Cq (Undetermined, `-1`, `NaN`, or an SDS/7500 `Ct` equal to the cycle count). |
| `cq_status` | `string` | yes | `determined` (a Cq), `undetermined` (no amplification: `cq` is null) or `no result`. |
| `cq_stored` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | The number the file stores for an undetermined result (SDS/7500 `.eds`: the cycle count, e.g. 40), kept for reference; never a Cq. |
| `cq_mean` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Mean Cq of the replicate group (vendor). |
| `cq_sd` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Standard deviation of the replicate group's Cq (vendor). |
| `tm` | array of `number` (double) | yes | Melting temperatures of the product, °C (vendor; several when the curve has several peaks). |
| `threshold` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Threshold the Cq was called at (vendor). |
| `auto_threshold` | `boolean` or `null` |  | Whether the vendor threshold was set automatically. |
| `baseline_start` | `integer` (uint32) or `null` |  | First cycle of the baseline window (vendor). |
| `baseline_end` | `integer` (uint32) or `null` |  | Last cycle of the baseline window (vendor). |
| `amp_status` | `string` or `null` |  | Amplification status (vendor). |
| `cq_confidence` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Cq confidence (vendor). |
| `calculated_quantity` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Quantity calculated by the vendor software from a standard curve. |
| `efficiency` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Amplification efficiency of this reaction (fold per cycle), when the file has one. |
| `excluded` | `string` or `null` |  | Why the result is excluded (omitted wells, RDML `excl`). |
| `flags` | array of `string` | yes | Vendor QC flags. |
| `vendor_delta_cq` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | ΔCq to the reference target as the vendor computed it (ΔΔCt experiments). |
| `vendor_rq` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Relative quantity as the vendor computed it. |
| `computed_cq` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Our threshold Cq (with `compute_cq`). |
| `computed_threshold` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Threshold our Cq used. |
| `computed_cq_status` | `string` or `null` |  | `determined` or `undetermined` for our Cq (with `compute_cq`; a curve that never crosses the threshold, or crosses it only at the last read, is undetermined). |
| `cycles` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Number of cycles in the amplification curve. |

### CqCounts

Cq statuses of a set of records.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `records` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Records (well × target). |
| `determined` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | With a Cq. |
| `undetermined` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Without a Cq because nothing amplified ("Undetermined"). |
| `no_result` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Without any result (not analysed, setup only). |
| `excluded` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Excluded or omitted in the file (counted in the other fields too). |

### TargetCqSummary

Per-target Cq summary over the records that match the filters.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | `string` | yes | Target. |
| `counts` | [`CqCounts`](#cqcounts) | yes | Record counts by status (every task, excluded records included in the counts). |
| `averaged` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Records averaged: not excluded, with a Cq (plus the undetermined ones when `undetermined_cq` is given). |
| `cq_mean` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Mean Cq of those records; undetermined results are left out unless `undetermined_cq` is given. |
| `cq_sd` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Sample standard deviation of those Cqs. |
| `cq_min` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Smallest Cq. |
| `cq_max` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Largest Cq. |

### CqComparison

Our threshold Cq against the vendor's, over every curve with a vendor result.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `method` | `string` | yes | How our Cq was computed. |
| `curves` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Curves compared. |
| `both_cq` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Both give a Cq. |
| `both_undetermined` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Both say there is no Cq. |
| `only_vendor` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Only the vendor gives a Cq. |
| `only_ours` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Only we give a Cq. |
| `vendor_threshold_used` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Curves where the threshold came from the file (the vendor's own). |
| `mean_difference` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Mean of (ours − vendor), cycles. |
| `mean_abs_difference` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Mean absolute difference, cycles. |
| `median_abs_difference` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Median absolute difference, cycles. |
| `max_abs_difference` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Largest absolute difference, cycles. |
| `within_0_1` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Fraction of `both_cq` within 0.1 cycles. |
| `within_0_5` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Fraction of `both_cq` within 0.5 cycles. |
| `pearson_r` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Pearson correlation of the two Cq lists. |

### RelativeQuantity

ΔΔCq relative quantification of one sample × target.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sample` | `string` | yes | Sample. |
| `target` | `string` | yes | Target of interest. |
| `replicates` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Replicate wells averaged: those with a Cq (plus the undetermined ones when `undetermined_cq` is given). |
| `undetermined` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Replicate wells of this sample × target without a Cq (undetermined): left out of the mean, or counted at `undetermined_cq` when the request gives one. |
| `cq_mean` | `number` (double) | yes | Mean Cq of the target in this sample. |
| `cq_sd` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Standard deviation of those Cqs. |
| `reference_cq_mean` | `number` (double) | yes | Mean Cq of the reference target(s) in this sample (arithmetic mean over references). |
| `delta_cq` | `number` (double) | yes | ΔCq = target − reference. |
| `delta_cq_sd` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | SD of ΔCq (target and reference SDs combined in quadrature). |
| `delta_delta_cq` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | ΔΔCq = ΔCq(sample) − ΔCq(control sample); `None` without a control. |
| `rq` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | 2^−ΔΔCq. |
| `rq_min` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | 2^−(ΔΔCq + SD). |
| `rq_max` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | 2^−(ΔΔCq − SD). |
| `efficiency_corrected_rq` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Efficiency-corrected ratio (Pfaffl) when every efficiency involved is known. |
| `vendor_delta_cq` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | ΔCq the vendor software computed for these wells, when stored. |
| `vendor_rq` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Relative quantity the vendor software computed, when stored. |

### StandardCurveFit

A standard curve fitted to the standard wells of one target.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | `string` | yes | Target. |
| `points` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Standard wells used. |
| `levels` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Distinct quantities. |
| `slope` | `number` (double) | yes | Slope of Cq against log10(quantity). |
| `intercept` | `number` (double) | yes | Cq at quantity 1. |
| `r2` | `number` (double) | yes | Coefficient of determination. |
| `efficiency_percent` | `number` (double) | yes | Efficiency, percent: (10^(−1/slope) − 1) × 100. |
| `vendor_slope` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | The vendor's slope for this target, when the file stores its standard curve. |
| `vendor_efficiency_percent` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | The vendor's efficiency, percent. |
| `vendor_r2` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | The vendor's r². |
